title: I Found a Lost Dog With a Reward Poster 🐕
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #dog #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I found a golden retriever wandering outside my house. Ten minutes later, I saw a poster. Lost dog, five hundred dollar reward.
scenes.image: a young man about 27 with short black hair, wearing a denim jacket kneeling beside a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face on a sidewalk, a lost dog poster on a lamp post

scenes.text: I called the number. An old man cried with joy and handed me the cash.
scenes.image: a kind elderly man about 70 with suspenders and a cardigan hugging a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face at his door and handing an envelope to a young man about 27 with short black hair, wearing a denim jacket

scenes.text: I felt like a hero. A week later, same dog, same street, no collar this time.
scenes.image: a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face sitting outside the house again, wagging his tail innocently

scenes.text: And a brand new poster. Different family. Seven hundred dollar reward.
scenes.image: a young man about 27 with short black hair, wearing a denim jacket looking at a different lost dog poster with the same dog's photo

scenes.text: I got suspicious. So I followed the dog for a whole day.
scenes.image: a young man about 27 with short black hair, wearing a denim jacket hiding behind a bush, spying on a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face trotting down a street

scenes.text: He visited four different houses. Four families. Four food bowls. Four beds.
scenes.image: montage of a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face being fed and petted at four different front doors

scenes.text: Every Friday he gets lost on purpose, someone finds him, and the families pay a reward. And he gets treats from everyone.
scenes.image: a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face lying on a pile of dog treats looking smug

scenes.text: I didn't report him. Now we split the reward money. He's the smartest business partner I've ever had.
scenes.image: a young man about 27 with short black hair, wearing a denim jacket and a clever golden retriever with a red collar and a mischievous face high-fiving, the dog wearing tiny sunglasses
